assign.request: Inventory every reference to LayoutTool in this repo so a later agent can rename it to DesignTool in one atomic sweep. Produce a manifest with categorized hits, atomic rename sequence, immutable records, and silent-failure risks.
assign.outcome: **1,166 references across 307 files.** Manifest complete: 95 files in directory (19 subdirs), 1,097 exact LayoutTool refs, 47 variants in historical logs, 20 in skills. Categorized: directory structure, JS imports (3 critical), URL corpus (50+ in audit, CRITICAL silent-failure risk), CSS classes (61 .lt-* rules), exported symbols (4), prose (100+ refs), skills (2 files), CLAUDE.md (0), historical task logs (immutable—DO NOT REWRITE). Atomic sequence: directory move → file renames → internal paths → external imports → docs. ~14 false positives from naive find-replace (task slug names layout-tool, layout-tool-live must stay unchanged).

links.label: Full manifest: categorized references, atomic sequence, do-not-rewrite principle, ranked risks
